I didn't bother with sauce. Often I'll do spices and olive oil instead of sauce.

Yeah I like to bake bread and homemade pizza doughs are really good. I use baker's percentages for bread recipes, in this case it was (one pizza, thick crust if small):
100% (100g) bread flour
65% (65g) water
20% (20g) olive oil
1.5% (1.5g) salt
About a teaspoon of yeast

I find that same day crusts tend to be bready, while if you mix up the dough and put it in the fridge overnight as a no knead bread, the texture more closely matches pizza shop dough.

You don't have to dedicate an entire room to VR gaming unless you're doing roomspace. Plenty of us were in to VR before roomspace was a thing.

This, it doesn't need motion controls, roomspace, and works completely fine as a seated experience with a controller or M+KB. Roomspace and motion controls are great options to have, but VR doesn't need either one to work. They are optional bonuses for those who have the space to take advantage of them, not requirements for everyone.

In fact, most of the best VR experiences I've had have been seated and with a standard X-input gamepad. In fact, VR can take up less space than a standard battlestation desktop setup depending on how you're using it.
